Loan Approval Project combines model scores with staffing, routing, policy and bottleneck analysis. It helps answer practical questions such as: what should we automate, what needs a human, where is the queue breaking, and what changes if demand spikes?

Business problem

Approval teams lose time in the gray zone.

Blanket manual review is slow. Aggressive automation can create inconsistent decisions. The analysis module manages that trade-off with confidence thresholds, analyst capacity and historical-agreement guardrails.

Project background

The project started as a college loan-classification project and was later extended with stronger modeling and business analysis.

The project demonstrates both model development and how analytics can support loan-review decisions, staffing scenarios, prioritization and bottleneck analysis.

01

Internship foundation

Cleaned and modeled a public loan-approval dataset, compared multiple classifiers, selected a model and shipped a Tkinter prediction interface.

02

ML engineering rebuild

Leakage-safe pipelines, stronger evaluation, explainability, FastAPI, tests, model artifacts, a second high-capacity dataset path and documented provenance.

03

Business Analysis extension

Turned prediction into policy optimization, analyst-capacity planning, queue prioritization, SLA analytics, root-cause segmentation, audit drill-downs and management summary.
